statements.text: Under the 2025 general transfer guidelines, employees who have completed five (5) years of service at a station as on 30-04-2025 shall be transferred compulsorily.
statements.quote: Employees who have completed five (5) years of service at a station as on 30-04-2025 shall be transferred compulsorily.

statements.text: Under the 2025 guidelines, employees who have completed less than two (2) years at a station shall not be transferred except on request or on administrative grounds.
statements.quote: Employees who have completed less than two (2) years at a station shall not be transferred except on request or on administrative grounds.

statements.text: The station period is computed with reference to the total continuous service.

statements.text: Periods of leave not exceeding six months are counted towards the station period.
statements.quote: Periods of leave not exceeding six months shall be counted towards the station period.

statements.text: When an employee is transferred within the same headquarters town, the service at both offices is treated as service at one station.
statements.quote: Where an employee has been transferred within the same headquarters town, the service at both offices shall be treated as service at one station.
